faq.q: How do I give some names a higher chance of being picked?
faq.a: Add a weight after a name with a colon, like Riya:3, and choose the Weighted pick mode (or the Raffle preset). A name with weight 3 is entered into the draw pool three times, so it is three times as likely as a weight-1 name. Weights must be whole numbers of at least 1; plain names default to weight 1.

faq.q: What pick modes and presets are available?
faq.a: Five modes: Single random winner, Pick N without repeats, Pick N with repeats allowed, Weighted pick, and Elimination (which removes the picked name from the list). Presets quickly configure these: Pick one, Pick a pair, Pick a group of 5, Split into 2 or 4 teams, Raffle, and Elimination round. The spinning wheel and a shuffle button are also provided.

Picks use crypto.getRandomValues() with rejection sampling to avoid modulo bias, so no name is secretly favoured. Note this is unbiased, not evenly distributed — a single random draw can land on the same name repeatedly. For fair participation over time, use Elimination mode so each name is removed once picked and can't be drawn again until you reset.

faq.q: Can I save my name lists and export results?
faq.a: Yes. Save named lists (e.g. "Class 10A") to browser localStorage, with a warning before overwriting an existing one. A pick history of up to 50 entries is kept. You can export lists as JSON, import JSON back, or use Export all (ZIP) which bundles each saved list as a .txt plus a pick-history.csv — the ZIP step loads JSZip on first use.
